idea-plugin.name: FeatherSpec Studio
idea-plugin.description:
FeatherSpec Studio is the visual command center for spec-driven development with FeatherSpec: it reads your specs, plans and Memory Bank, shows where every spec stands, and names each spec's next FeatherSpec step.

  • Specs tool window: your specs in four groups, each with its next step.
  • Overview, Board and Plan map in an editor tab, in the colours of your IDE theme.
  • Copy prompt: the exact FeatherSpec prompt on your clipboard, ready to paste into your AI assistant.
  • Send to Junie, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot types the prompt and its file mentions into that assistant's command-line agent in the IDE terminal (junie, claude, copilot); when you click it, it may start the agent in a new terminal tab. It never presses Enter. An assistant is offered only while its command is on the IDE's PATH.

The Studio sends nothing. It is local and read-only: no account, no telemetry; the one network call is the FeatherSpec download you start with Set up FeatherSpec. It needs the IDE's embedded browser (JCEF).

It runs in IntelliJ-based IDEs from version 2025.3.1: Rider, WebStorm, PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, CLion, RubyMine and RustRover. It is tested in Rider and WebStorm; the other IDEs are checked with the JetBrains Plugin Verifier.

Junie, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot are products of their owners; FeatherSpec Studio works with them and is not affiliated with them. Source, documentation and privacy: github.com/GregorBiswanger/featherspec-studio.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First release on the JetBrains Marketplace: the Specs tool window, Overview, Board and Plan map, the status bar entry and the settings, with the same next steps as the VS Code extension. The setting Assistant offers Send to Junie, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, which type into the command-line agent in the IDE terminal and never press Enter; Copy prompt stays in every menu. Full history: CHANGELOG.md on GitHub.
